name: Sweep Stakes
desc: Earn chips when a full board triggers a floor clear.

name: Rail Tax
desc: Earn chips whenever a card hits the bumper arch above a full column.

name: Premium Cut
desc: Chance to deal Silver, Gold, or Diamond cards. Each premium card in a scored hand boosts that hand's payout.

name: Wild Card
desc: Chance to deal a wild card that counts as any suit for flushes. Higher levels deal them more often.

name: Pin Tip
desc: Earn chips whenever a card bounces off a peg.

name: Felt Grease
desc: Balls fall and settle faster. Late levels keep speeding up, with diminishing returns.

name: Short Fuse
desc: Cards explode faster. Toggle Off to slow clears when stacking combos or Card Counting pairs.

name: Multi Deal
desc: Chance each auto deal spawns an extra card. Above 100% can spawn multiple. Caps at 150%.

name: High Cut
desc: Remove the lowest ranks from the deck.

name: Suit Purge
desc: Blow up every card of one suit on the board for chip payout. Recharges over time; levels shorten the wait. Toggle or tap the bar to hide the suit picker.

name: Suit Alliance
desc: Combine suits for flushes and Suit Purge. Lv1: diamonds count as hearts. Lv2: clubs count as spades.

name: Cashier's Cage
desc: Too many chips? Each buy adds +1 Cash Out comp.
